data.why: tests/data/test_participant.nii is the repository's own 4D NIFTI test fixture, a realistic head-motion-corrected fMRI file to drag into the uploader; streamlit/streamlit.py is seeded with a one-line fix (removing the width=None argument to st.image, which newer Streamlit releases reject) so the app's first screen renders instead of crashing.

goals: Upload a head-motion-corrected 4D fMRI NIFTI file and confirm the eyeball voxels are extracted
Select a pretrained model matched to the eye-movement paradigm (e.g. guided fixations vs. pursuit)
Decode the per-TR gaze X/Y time series from the MR signal of the eyeballs
Inspect per-sub-TR gaze estimates and their uncertainty alongside the median estimates
Download the decoded gaze coordinates as CSV files for further analysis

review.summary: The goal and the setup half are accurate and well evidenced: the model choice with its training papers and the NIfTI upload are captured faithfully, and 8 of the 9 screens I checked match their nodes. The weights download failed in the sandbox, so the tree is built around that failure and is missing the review-and-export half the README says the app is for, which needs a rerun with seeded weights or nodes built from the code before it is filed.
